FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Interactive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Listening.

2. When practising Active Listening Attention Engagement Vocabulary, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening Attention Engagement Vocabulary.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening Attention Engagement Vocabulary.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening Attention Engagement Vocabulary.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening Attention Engagement Vocabulary.

   A. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.

   C. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.

7. When practising Listening for Information Attention Note taking Vocabulary, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information Attention Note taking Vocabulary.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information Attention Note taking Vocabulary.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information Attention Note taking Vocabulary.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information Attention Note taking Vocabulary.

8. The French word for “book” is: (1 mark)
   A. chaise
   B. porte
   C. livre
   D. fenêtre

9. “Bonjour” is used to say: (1 mark)
   A. Good night only
   B. Thank you
   C. Excuse me
   D. Good morning / hello

10. When practising Active listening 1.4 Listening for information, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Copy random text without understanding Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.

----
